# Ignore list removal after device add (2026-02-07 18:08Z)

_**User**_

when the user adds  and allows the a device from the visitor history or unknown visitors list and it was ignored previously it should be removed also from the ignore list after being added

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>

The user wants to ensure that when a device is added and allowed from the visitor history or unknown visitors list, and that device was previously on the ignore list, it should be removed from the ignore list after being added.

Let me search for how the "allow device" flow works and where the ignore list is managed, so I can add the logic to remove the device from the ignore list when it's added/allowed.
</details></think>

Save mutates &#96;KnownDevice&#96;.\n3. Full-list sync is triggered.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.\n\n### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User deletes device.\n2. Remove locally.\n3. Re-send full list without removed device.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.\n\n---\n\n## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)\n\n- Data source:\n  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;\n  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.\n- UI:\n  - New section above known devices.\n  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.\n  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.\n- Visibility:\n  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.\n\n---\n\n## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication\n\nThe feature text should explicitly explain:\n\n- It is optional.\n- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.\n- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.\n- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.\n\nSuggested short onboarding title/body:\n\n- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”\n- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n    \n    @MainActor\n    private func saveDevice() async {\n        isSaving = true\n        saveError = nil\n        \n        // Capture snapshot for rollback\n        let snapshot = AllowedDeviceListManager.shared.captureSnapshot()\n        \n        let uiColor = UIColor(deviceColor)\n        let newDevice = KnownDevice(\n            name: deviceName,\n            deviceID: deviceID,\n            color: uiColor,\n            hasCurrentLocationAccess: hasCurrentLocationAccess,\n            hasHistoryAccess: hasHistoryAccess\n        )\n        \n        let success = store.add(device: newDevice)\n        if !success {\n            Haptic.notifyWarning()\n            showDuplicateAlert = true\n            isSaving = false\n            return\n        }\n        \n        // If feature is enabled, sync to server\n        if settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled {\n            do {\n                try await AllowedDeviceListManager.shared.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .add)\n                Haptic.notifySuccess()\n                isPresented = false\n            } catch {\n                // Rollback on sync failure\n                AllowedDeviceListManager.shared.restoreSnapshot(snapshot)\n                saveError = error.localizedDescription\n                Haptic.notifyWarning()\n                debugLog(\"[AddDevice] Sync failed, rolled back: \\(error)\")\n            }\n        } else {\n            Haptic.notifySuccess()\n            isPresented = false\n        }\n        \n        isSaving = false\n    }\n}\n\nstruct iPhone_AddDeviceView_Previews: PreviewProvider {\n    static var previews: some View {\n        // Beispiel-Daten für die Vorschau\n        let store = KnownDeviceStore.shared\n        iPhone_AddDeviceView(store: store, isPresented: .constant(true))\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "**6. Settings entry** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- Add section for allowed device list feature\n- Show feature status (enabled/disabled)\n- If enabled: show informational text, no disable action\n- If disabled: show enable action (triggers activation flow)\n\n**7. Device dialogs — Add Device** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_AddDeviceView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_AddDeviceView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- Conditional UI: only show ACL toggles when &#96;SettingsManager.shared.allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;\n- Defaults: &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess = true&#96;, &#96;hasHistoryAccess = false&#96; for new devices\n- On save: add to &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, then call &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .add)&#96;\n- Rollback on sync failure: restore pre-add snapshot, show error\n\n**8. Device dialogs — Edit Device** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_EditDeviceView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_EditDeviceView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- Conditional UI: only show ACL toggles when feature enabled\n- Load existing ACL values from &#96;KnownDevice&#96;\n- On save: update &#96;KnownDevice&#96;, then sync full list\n- Rollback on sync failure: restore previous ACL values\n\n**9. Device removal** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- When feature enabled and device deleted: capture snapshot, remove locally, sync full list\n- Rollback on sync failure: restore device with previous ACLs\n\n**10. Unknown visitors section** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- Data source: filter &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96; for unique DeviceIDs not in &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; and not in &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;\n- UI: new section above known devices list, only visible when list is non-empty\n- Row display: DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; with prefilled DeviceID + ACL controls (defaults: &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;)",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 44
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Allowed Device List Feature — Implementation Plan\n\n## 1) Current state (what already exists)\n\nBased on the current codebase:\n\n- The API layer already supports &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with per-device access flags (&#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess&#96;, &#96;hasHistoryAccess&#96;) and requires both &#96;DeviceID&#96; and &#96;DeviceKey&#96;. This is exposed in &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList(...)&#96;.\n- The app already supports optional DeviceKey management (&#96;SettingsManager.deviceKey&#96;, onboarding page, settings sheet, auth mismatch handling).\n- Known devices are persisted via &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; and represented by &#96;KnownDevice&#96; (currently name, id, color, ordering/group info).\n- Visitor history is already loaded and displayed (&#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel&#96; / visitor history views), including an “add unknown visitor as device” flow.\n\nThis makes the new feature mostly an app-domain/state-management and UX integration project, not a protocol design project.\n\n---\n\n## 2) Key product decisions and rationale\n\n### Decision A: How to track whether the allowed-device-list feature is enabled\n\n**Choose:** explicit immutable activation flag + persisted per-device ACL fields.\n\n- Add a dedicated setting flag, e.g. &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool&#96; in &#96;SettingsManager&#96;.\n- Add ACL fields to each &#96;KnownDevice&#96;:\n  - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool&#96;\n  - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool&#96;\n\n**Why this over “infer from list existence” only?**\n\n- Inference from list/data shape is brittle during migration or partial failures.\n- An explicit flag cleanly models the “one-way activation” requirement (“cannot be disabled”).\n- Per-device ACL fields remain the source of truth for payload generation once enabled.\n\n**Implications:**\n\n- Migration needs defaults for older archived devices.\n- Guardrails are easy: UI and sync logic can branch on &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96;.\n- If enabled but server sync fails, state handling must remain deterministic (see rollout/sync section).\n\n### Decision B: One-way activation behavior\n\n**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).",

        "contents": "struct VisitorHistorySection: View {\n    @ObservedObject var viewModel: VisitorHistoryViewModel\n    @ObservedObject var deviceStore: KnownDeviceStore\n    @ObservedObject var ignoredStore = IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore.shared\n    @Binding var pendingDeviceItem: DeviceIDItem?\n    let isLandscape: Bool\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: isLandscape ? .headline : .title3)\n            \n            VisitorHistoryStateView(viewModel: viewModel) { visitors in\n                LazyVStack(spacing: 8) {\n                    ForEach(visitors, id: \\.uniqueID) { visitor in\n                        VisitorHistoryRow(\n                            visitor: visitor,\n                            knownDevice: deviceStore.devices.first { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() == visitor.DeviceID.uppercased() },\n                            isIgnored: ignoredStore.isIgnored(deviceID: visitor.DeviceID),\n                            onAddDevice: {\n                                pendingDeviceItem = DeviceIDItem(id: visitor.DeviceID, deviceID: visitor.DeviceID)\n                            },\n                            onIgnore: {\n                                ignoredStore.addIgnored(deviceID: visitor.DeviceID)\n                            },\n                            onUnignore: {\n                                ignoredStore.removeIgnored(deviceID: visitor.DeviceID)\n                            }\n                        )\n                        if visitor.uniqueID != visitors.last?.uniqueID {\n                            Divider()\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct iPhone_VisitorHistoryView: View {\n    @StateObject private var deviceStore = KnownDeviceStore.shared",

        "contents": "    private var unknownVisitors: [MiataruVisitor] {\n        let knownDeviceIDs = Set(store.devices.map { $0.DeviceID.uppercased() })\n        let ignoredDeviceIDs = Set(ignoredStore.ignoredDeviceIDs.map { $0.uppercased() })\n        \n        // Get unique DeviceIDs from visitors, keeping the most recent visit for each\n        var uniqueVisitors: [String: MiataruVisitor] = [:]\n        for visitor in visitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors {\n            let normalizedID = visitor.DeviceID.uppercased()\n            if !knownDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedID) &amp;&amp; !ignoredDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedID) &amp;&amp; !normalizedID.isEmpty {\n                if let existing = uniqueVisitors[normalizedID] {\n                    // Keep the most recent visit\n                    if visitor.TimeStampDate &gt; existing.TimeStampDate {\n                        uniqueVisitors[normalizedID] = visitor\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    uniqueVisitors[normalizedID] = visitor\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \n        return Array(uniqueVisitors.values).sorted { $0.TimeStampDate &gt; $1.TimeStampDate }\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        NavigationStack(path: $navigationPath) {\n            ",

        "contents": "This keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.\n\n### 3.3 UI flow integration\n\n1. **Onboarding**\n   - Add a dedicated onboarding page for allowed-device-list.\n   - Reuse the same image asset as DeviceKey onboarding.\n   - CTA logic:\n     - If no DeviceKey: primary action opens DeviceKey setup first.\n     - If DeviceKey exists and feature disabled: show enable/setup action.\n     - If already enabled: show configured/success state.\n2. **Settings**\n   - Add entry to review/manage feature state and explanatory text.\n   - Do not provide “disable” action once enabled.\n3. **Add/Edit device dialogs**\n   - If feature is enabled, show two translated toggles.\n   - If feature is **not** enabled yet, keep add/edit/delete dialogs in their current form and do **not** show ACL toggles.\n   - Edit defaults: existing stored values.\n   - Add defaults (requirement): &#96;current = true&#96;, &#96;history = false&#96; for new devices.\n4. **Devices list unknown section**\n   - Add top section only when unknown devices exist in visitor history and are not ignored.\n   - Actions per row:\n     - **Allow/Add** → open add flow with prefilled DeviceID and ACL defaults, then sync full list.\n     - **Ignore/Disallow** → add ID to ignored store (hidden from this list), no deletion from full visitor history.\n\n---\n\n## 4) End-to-end behavior design\n\n### 4.1 Activation sequence\n\n1. User starts allowed-device-list setup (onboarding/settings).\n2. App checks DeviceKey.\n3. If missing, prompt DeviceKey creation first.\n4. On DeviceKey success, build full ACL payload from known devices with initial defaults (&#96;true/true&#96;).\n5. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n6. On ACK, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96;.\n7. From now on, all device list mutations trigger full-list sync.\n\n\n### 4.1a UI gating before feature activation\n\n- Until &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, existing add/change/delete device dialogs remain unchanged.\n- No access-rights toggle controls are rendered in these dialogs before activation.\n- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport Combine\n\nclass IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore()\n    \n    @Published private(set) var ignoredDeviceIDs: [String] = []\n    \n    private let defaults = UserDefaults.standard\n    private let key = \"ignored_visitor_device_ids\"\n    \n    private init() {\n        self.ignoredDeviceIDs = getIgnoredDeviceIDs()\n    }\n    \n    /// Adds a device ID to the ignored list\n    func addIgnored(deviceID: String) {\n        let normalizedID = deviceID.uppercased()\n        if !ignoredDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedID) {\n            ignoredDeviceIDs.append(normalizedID)\n            defaults.set(ignoredDeviceIDs, forKey: key)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Removes a device ID from the ignored list\n    func removeIgnored(deviceID: String) {\n        let normalizedID = deviceID.uppercased()\n        ignoredDeviceIDs.removeAll { $0 == normalizedID }\n        defaults.set(ignoredDeviceIDs, forKey: key)\n    }\n    \n    /// Checks if a device ID is in the ignored list\n    func isIgnored(deviceID: String) -&gt; Bool {\n        let normalizedID = deviceID.uppercased()\n        return ignoredDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedID)\n    }\n    \n    /// Returns all ignored device IDs\n    func getAllIgnoredDeviceIDs() -&gt; [String] {\n        return ignoredDeviceIDs\n    }\n    \n    private func getIgnoredDeviceIDs() -&gt; [String] {\n        return defaults.stringArray(forKey: key) ?? []\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: Allowed Device List Feature\noverview: Implement optional per-device access control (current location and history) with one-way activation, server synchronization, and unknown visitor management. The feature requires DeviceKey and cannot be disabled once enabled.\ntodos:\n  - id: phase1-data-model\n    content: Extend KnownDevice with ACL fields (hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess) and update NSCoding for backward compatibility\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-settings\n    content: Add allowedDeviceListEnabled flag to SettingsManager with UserDefaults persistence\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-ignored-store\n    content: Create IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore singleton for dismissed unknown devices\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-manager\n    content: Implement AllowedDeviceListManager with payload building, sync queue, and transactional rollback\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-onboarding\n    content: Create iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView and integrate into onboarding containers\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-settings-ui\n    content: Add settings entry for allowed device list feature with status display\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-add-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_AddDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-edit-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_EditDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-remove-sync\n    content: Wire device removal to sync full list when feature enabled\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase4-unknown-section\n    content: Add unknown visitors section to iPhone_DevicesView with allow/ignore actions\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-localization\n    content: Add all feature strings to Localizable.xcstrings and run export workflow\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-testing\n    content: Write unit tests for payload mapping, backward compatibility, and sync queue\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"",

        "contents": "    func restoreSnapshot(_ snapshot: [KnownDeviceSnapshot]) {\n        // Remove all current devices\n        let currentDeviceIDs = deviceStore.devices.map { $0.DeviceID }\n        currentDeviceIDs.forEach { deviceStore.removeDevice(byID: $0) }\n        \n        // Restore from snapshot\n        for snap in snapshot {\n            let device = KnownDevice(\n                name: snap.deviceName,\n                deviceID: snap.deviceID,\n                color: snap.deviceColor,\n                hasCurrentLocationAccess: snap.hasCurrentLocationAccess,\n                hasHistoryAccess: snap.hasHistoryAccess\n            )\n            device.DeviceIsInGroup = snap.deviceIsInGroup\n            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = snap.knownDevicesTablePosition\n            deviceStore.add(device: device)\n        }\n        \n        // Restore ordering\n        let sortedDevices = deviceStore.devices.sorted { $0.KnownDevicesTablePosition &lt; $1.KnownDevicesTablePosition }\n        deviceStore.devices = sortedDevices\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Helpers\n    \n    private func buildPayloadFromDevices() -&gt; [MiataruAllowedDevice] {\n        let payload = deviceStore.devices.map { device in\n            MiataruAllowedDevice(\n                DeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                hasCurrentLocationAccess: device.hasCurrentLocationAccess,\n                hasHistoryAccess: device.hasHistoryAccess\n            )\n        }\n        debugLog(\"[AllowedDeviceListManager] Building payload with \\(payload.count) devices\")\n        for item in payload {\n            debugLog(\"[AllowedDeviceListManager] Device \\(item.DeviceID): current=\\(item.hasCurrentLocationAccess), history=\\(item.hasHistoryAccess)\")\n        }\n        return payload\n    }\n    \n    private func performSync(\n        serverURL: URL,\n        deviceKey: String,\n        payload: [MiataruAllowedDevice],\n        trigger: SyncTrigger,\n        maxRetries: Int\n    ) async throws {\n        var lastError: Error?\n        var retryCount = 0",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).\n  2. Build payload from all known devices (defaults &#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices).\n  3. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n  4. On success, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96; and ACL values.\n\n**Why:** avoids a local “enabled but never seeded” state on first setup.\n\n### Decision C: Canonical synchronization model\n\n**Choose:** when enabled, local known-device list is canonical and server ACL is overwritten with full list on each relevant mutation.\n\n- Mutations: add/remove device, edit ACL toggles, onboarding activation, unknown-device allow/disallow action.\n- Use one central orchestrator service to avoid duplicate ad-hoc sync code.\n\n---\n\n## 3) Architecture changes\n\n## 3.1 Data model and persistence\n\n1. Extend &#96;KnownDevice&#96; to include ACL fields:\n   - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n   - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n2. Update &#96;NSCoding&#96; encode/decode keys with backward-compatible defaults.\n3. Add &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; to &#96;SettingsManager.Keys&#96; and initialize from &#96;UserDefaults&#96;.\n4. Add a local ignored-unknown-devices store (e.g. &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;) containing device IDs explicitly dismissed from the Devices screen unknown list.\n\n### 3.2 Domain service layer (new)\n\nCreate &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96; (singleton or injected service) responsible for:\n\n- Building API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96;.\n- Enforcing preconditions (&#96;deviceKey != nil &amp;&amp; !empty&#96;, valid server URL).\n- Calling &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n- Exposing high-level methods:\n  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList()&#96;\n  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger:)&#96;\n  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:..., hasCurrentLocationAccess:..., hasHistoryAccess:...)&#96;\n  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:...)&#96;\n- Centralized error mapping/user messages/logging.\n\nThis keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- Activation button triggers:",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Build payload from all known devices (defaults &#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices).",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. On success, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96; and ACL values.",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "**Why:** avoids a local “enabled but never seeded” state on first setup.",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "### Decision C: Canonical synchronization model",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "**Choose:** when enabled, local known-device list is canonical and server ACL is overwritten with full list on each relevant mutation.",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- Mutations: add/remove device, edit ACL toggles, onboarding activation, unknown-device allow/disallow action.",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use one central orchestrator service to avoid duplicate ad-hoc sync code.",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3) Architecture changes",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3.1 Data model and persistence",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Extend &#96;KnownDevice&#96; to include ACL fields:",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool = true&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool = true&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Update &#96;NSCoding&#96; encode/decode keys with backward-compatible defaults.",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Add &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; to &#96;SettingsManager.Keys&#96; and initialize from &#96;UserDefaults&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Add a local ignored-unknown-devices store (e.g. &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;) containing device IDs explicitly dismissed from the Devices screen unknown list.",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 Domain service layer (new)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "Create &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96; (singleton or injected service) responsible for:",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- Building API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- Enforcing preconditions (&#96;deviceKey != nil &amp;&amp; !empty&#96;, valid server URL).",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- Calling &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "- Exposing high-level methods:",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList()&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger:)&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:..., hasCurrentLocationAccess:..., hasHistoryAccess:...)&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:...)&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "- Centralized error mapping/user messages/logging.",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "This keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.",
            "lineNumber": 85
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "## Implementation Details\n\n### Mutual Navigation Detection Logic\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nfunc isMutualNavigation(targetDeviceId: String) -&gt; Bool {\n    guard navigationActiveTo(targetDeviceId) else { return false }\n    \n    let lastSeen = newestVisitorHistoryEntry(visitorDeviceId: targetDeviceId)\n    guard let lastSeen else { return false }\n    \n    let age = Date().timeIntervalSince(lastSeen.TimeStampDate)\n    \n    // Hysteresis: different thresholds for enter/exit\n    if isCurrentlyMutual {\n        return age &lt;= 90.0  // T_exit\n    } else {\n        return age &lt;= 60.0  // T_enter\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Visitor History Row Display\n\n- Known device: Show &#96;KnownDevice.DeviceName&#96; prominently\n- Unknown device: Show localized \"Unknown Device\" label + shortened deviceId (first 6 + last 4 chars)\n  - Use: &#96;NSLocalizedString(\"unknown_device_label\", comment: \"Label for unknown/unrecognized device\")&#96;\n- Timestamp: Relative time using localized format string\n  - Use: &#96;NSLocalizedString(\"time_ago_minutes\", comment: \"Time ago format, e.g., '5 min ago' or 'vor 5 Min.'\")&#96;\n  - Format with &#96;DateComponentsFormatter&#96; for proper localization\n  - Optionally show absolute timestamp as secondary text\n\n### Add Device Flow Reuse\n\nTwo approaches:\n\n1. **Direct sheet presentation** (simpler):\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   @State private var showAddDeviceSheet = false\n   @State private var pendingDeviceID: String? = nil\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\nShow sheet with &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView(store: KnownDeviceStore.shared, isPresented: $showAddDeviceSheet, prefillDeviceID: pendingDeviceID)&#96;\n\n2. **Deep link simulation** (reuses existing flow):\n\nCreate URL &#96;miataru://{deviceID}&#96; and call &#96;handleIncomingURL&#96;\n\nPrefer approach 1 for simplicity and direct control.\n\n## Testing\n\n**Unit Tests:**\n\n1. &#96;MutualNavigationDetectorTests&#96;:\n\n   - Test hysteresis logic (enter at 60s, exit at 90s)\n   - Test state transitions\n   - Test polling behavior\n\n2. &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModelTests&#96;:\n\n   - Test known vs unknown device resolution",

        "contents": "- Row display: DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; with prefilled DeviceID + ACL controls (defaults: &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;)\n  - **Ignore**: add to &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;, remove from section immediately\n- Optional: add \"Ignored Devices\" management screen in settings to reverse ignore actions\n\n### Synchronization Model\n\n**11. Full-list sync on mutations**\nWhen &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, trigger full-list sync on:\n\n- Device add (via &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .add)&#96;)\n- Device edit/ACL change (trigger: &#96;.edit&#96;)\n- Device remove (trigger: &#96;.remove&#96;)\n- Unknown device allow (trigger: &#96;.unknownAllow&#96;)\n- Initial activation (trigger: &#96;.activation&#96;)\n\n**12. Transactional rollback pattern**\nFor all mutations when feature enabled:\n\n1. Capture snapshot: full &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96; array (including ACL values, ordering)\n2. Apply local mutation optimistically\n3. Attempt sync with retry policy (exponential backoff)\n4. On final failure: restore snapshot, persist immediately, show error banner with retry action\n5. Log telemetry: trigger, retry count, error class, rollback performed\n\n### Migration Strategy\n\n**13. Backward compatibility**\n\n- &#96;KnownDevice.init(coder:)&#96;: decode ACL keys with defaults &#96;true/true&#96; if absent\n- &#96;SettingsManager.init()&#96;: &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; defaults to &#96;false&#96; when key missing\n- First launch after update: verify all devices have ACL values in-memory, save archive once (no server call)\n\n**14. Migration safety**\n\n- Existing users remain with feature disabled until explicit activation\n- No silent server ACL writes before opt-in\n- Older archived &#96;knownDevices.plist&#96; files load gracefully with default ACLs\n\n### Internationalization\n\n**15. Localization strings** (&#96;[miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings](miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings)&#96;)\nAdd keys for:\n\n- Feature title, body, CTA labels\n- ACL toggle labels/descriptions (\"Current Location Access\", \"History Access\")\n- Unknown visitor section title, allow/ignore buttons",

        "contents": "            return true\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Error refreshing device locations: \\(error)\")\n            // Remove all device locations from cache if download fails (on main thread)\n            await MainActor.run {\n                for deviceID in deviceIDs {\n                    cache.removeLocation(for: deviceID)\n                }\n            }\n            return false\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Fetches visitor history for the current user's device and updates cache with devices that have looked for the user in the past 90 seconds.\n    /// - Parameter serverURL: The server URL to fetch visitor history from\n    private func refreshVisitorHistory(serverURL: URL) async {\n        let currentDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        \n        do {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceLocationRefresher] refreshVisitorHistory for device \\(currentDeviceID)\")\n            // Request a reasonable amount of visitor history entries (enough to cover 90 seconds)\n            // Assuming updates happen every few seconds, requesting 50 entries should be sufficient\n            APIRequestCounter.shared.record(.getVisitorHistory)\n            let visitors = try await MiataruAPIClient.getVisitorHistory(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                forDeviceID: currentDeviceID,\n                deviceKey: settings.deviceKey,\n                amount: 50\n            )\n            \n            // Calculate cutoff time: 90 seconds ago\n            let cutoffTime = Date().addingTimeInterval(-90)\n            \n            // Filter visitors from the past 90 seconds and get unique device IDs\n            let recentVisitorDeviceIDs = Set(visitors\n                .filter { $0.TimeStampDate &gt;= cutoffTime }\n                .map { $0.DeviceID })\n            \n            // Update cache on main thread\n            await MainActor.run {\n                cache.setRecentVisitorDeviceIDs(recentVisitorDeviceIDs)\n            }\n            \n            debugLog(\"[DeviceLocationRefresher] Found \\(recentVisitorDeviceIDs.count) devices that looked for current user in past 90 seconds\")\n        } catch {\n            _ = DeviceKeyAuthHandler.handle(error: error)",

        "contents": "- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.\n2. UI shows ACL toggles with defaults &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;.\n3. On save, add to &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, then sync full list.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback to pre-add snapshot and show a localized error explaining restoration.\n\n### 4.3 Edit device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User edits toggles.\n2. Save mutates &#96;KnownDevice&#96;.\n3. Full-list sync is triggered.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.\n\n### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User deletes device.\n2. Remove locally.\n3. Re-send full list without removed device.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.\n\n---\n\n## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)\n\n- Data source:\n  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;\n  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.\n- UI:\n  - New section above known devices.\n  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.\n  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.\n- Visibility:\n  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.\n\n---\n\n## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication\n\nThe feature text should explicitly explain:\n\n- It is optional.\n- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.\n- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.\n- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.\n\nSuggested short onboarding title/body:\n\n- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”\n- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",

        "contents": "---\nname: Allowed Device List Feature\noverview: Implement optional per-device access control (current location and history) with one-way activation, server synchronization, and unknown visitor management. The feature requires DeviceKey and cannot be disabled once enabled.\ntodos:\n  - id: phase1-data-model\n    content: Extend KnownDevice with ACL fields (hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess) and update NSCoding for backward compatibility\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-settings\n    content: Add allowedDeviceListEnabled flag to SettingsManager with UserDefaults persistence\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-ignored-store\n    content: Create IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore singleton for dismissed unknown devices\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-manager\n    content: Implement AllowedDeviceListManager with payload building, sync queue, and transactional rollback\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-onboarding\n    content: Create iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView and integrate into onboarding containers\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-settings-ui\n    content: Add settings entry for allowed device list feature with status display\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-add-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_AddDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-edit-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_EditDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-remove-sync\n    content: Wire device removal to sync full list when feature enabled\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase4-unknown-section\n    content: Add unknown visitors section to iPhone_DevicesView with allow/ignore actions\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-localization\n    content: Add all feature strings to Localizable.xcstrings and run export workflow\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-testing\n    content: Write unit tests for payload mapping, backward compatibility, and sync queue\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"",

        "contents": "    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {\n        // Get device IDs that will be removed\n        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }\n        \n        // Remove devices from the list\n        devices.remove(atOffsets: offsets)\n        \n        // Remove devices from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: deviceIDsToRemove)\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    func removeDevice(byID deviceID: String) {\n        // Remove device from the list\n        devices.removeAll { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }\n        \n        // Remove device from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [deviceID])\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    private func removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [String]) {\n        let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared\n        \n        for group in groupStore.groups {\n            var changed = false\n            for deviceID in deviceIDs {\n                if group.deviceIDs.contains(deviceID) {\n                    group.removeDevice(deviceID)\n                    changed = true\n                }\n            }\n            if changed {\n                group.objectWillChange.send()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} ",

        "contents": "            .onChange(of: settings.lastOpenedDeviceID) { _, newDeviceID in\n                guard let deviceID = newDeviceID,\n                      store.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) else { return }\n                let requestedID = deviceID\n                Task { @MainActor in\n                    // If we’re already showing the requested device (normal in-app navigation),\n                    // do nothing to avoid a visible pop/push animation.\n                    if navigationPath.last == .device(requestedID) {\n                        return\n                    }\n\n                    // Clear first, then set after a short delay to override any restored navigation state.\n                    navigationPath = []\n                    await Task.yield()\n                    try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n                    // Guard against a stale delayed task (e.g. multiple widget taps).\n                    guard settings.lastOpenedDeviceID == requestedID else { return }\n                    navigationPath = [.device(requestedID)]\n                }\n            }\n            // Intentionally do not reset didAutoNavigateFromSavedDevice on\n            // changes to lastOpenedDeviceID to avoid unintended re-pushes\n        }\n    }\n    \n    @MainActor\n    private func removeDevice(deviceID: String) async {\n        if settings.allowedDeviceListEnabled {\n            do {\n                try await AllowedDeviceListManager.shared.removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID: deviceID)\n                Haptic.notifySuccess()\n            } catch {\n                Haptic.notifyWarning()\n                debugLog(\"[DevicesView] Failed to remove device with sync: \\(error)\")\n                // Device removal will be rolled back by AllowedDeviceListManager\n            }\n        } else {\n            store.removeDevice(byID: deviceID)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate enum NavigationDestination: Hashable {\n    case device(String)\n    case group(String)\n}\n\nstruct UnknownVisitorRow: View {\n    let visitor: MiataruVisitor",

        "contents": "**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).\n  2. Build payload from all known devices (defaults &#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices).\n  3. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n  4. On success, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96; and ACL values.\n\n**Why:** avoids a local “enabled but never seeded” state on first setup.\n\n### Decision C: Canonical synchronization model\n\n**Choose:** when enabled, local known-device list is canonical and server ACL is overwritten with full list on each relevant mutation.\n\n- Mutations: add/remove device, edit ACL toggles, onboarding activation, unknown-device allow/disallow action.\n- Use one central orchestrator service to avoid duplicate ad-hoc sync code.\n\n---\n\n## 3) Architecture changes\n\n## 3.1 Data model and persistence\n\n1. Extend &#96;KnownDevice&#96; to include ACL fields:\n   - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n   - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool = true&#96;\n2. Update &#96;NSCoding&#96; encode/decode keys with backward-compatible defaults.\n3. Add &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; to &#96;SettingsManager.Keys&#96; and initialize from &#96;UserDefaults&#96;.\n4. Add a local ignored-unknown-devices store (e.g. &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;) containing device IDs explicitly dismissed from the Devices screen unknown list.\n\n### 3.2 Domain service layer (new)\n\nCreate &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96; (singleton or injected service) responsible for:\n\n- Building API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96;.\n- Enforcing preconditions (&#96;deviceKey != nil &amp;&amp; !empty&#96;, valid server URL).\n- Calling &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n- Exposing high-level methods:\n  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList()&#96;\n  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger:)&#96;\n  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:..., hasCurrentLocationAccess:..., hasHistoryAccess:...)&#96;\n  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:...)&#96;\n- Centralized error mapping/user messages/logging.\n\nThis keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.",

Create &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore**&#96; (new file)\n\n- Singleton store for device IDs explicitly dismissed from unknown visitor list\n- Persist to &#96;UserDefaults&#96; or separate plist file\n- Methods: &#96;addIgnored(deviceID:)&#96;, &#96;isIgnored(deviceID:)&#96;, &#96;removeIgnored(deviceID:)&#96;\n\n### Domain Service Layer\n\n**4. Create &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager**&#96; (new file: &#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/AllowedDeviceListManager.swift&#96;)\n\n- Singleton service for ACL synchronization\n- Responsibilities:\n  - Build API payload from &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96; → &#96;[MiataruAllowedDevice]&#96;\n  - Enforce preconditions (DeviceKey exists, server URL valid)\n  - Call &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with retry logic\n  - Serialized sync queue to prevent race conditions\n  - Transactional rollback on final sync failure\n- Public methods:\n  - &#96;activateAllowedDeviceList() async throws&#96;\n  - &#96;syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: SyncTrigger) async throws&#96;\n  - &#96;upsertDeviceACL(deviceID:hasCurrentLocationAccess:hasHistoryAccess:) async throws&#96;\n  - &#96;removeDeviceAndSync(deviceID:) async throws&#96;\n- Error handling: map API errors to user-facing messages, log trigger context\n\n### UI Integration\n\n**5. Onboarding page** (new file: &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/Onboarding/iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView.swift&#96;)\n\n- Reuse &#96;devicekey&#96; image asset\n- Title: \"Control which devices can access your location data\"\n- Body: explains optional feature, DeviceKey requirement, irreversible activation\n- CTA logic:\n  - If no DeviceKey: primary action opens DeviceKey setup sheet\n  - If DeviceKey exists and feature disabled: show enable button\n  - If already enabled: show configured state\n- Add to onboarding containers: &#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_OnboardingContainerView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_OnboardingContainerView.swift)&#96; and iPad/Mac equivalents\n\n**6. Settings entry** (&#96;[miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift](miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift)&#96;)\n\n- Add section for allowed device list feature",

        },
        "contents": "- Row display: DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; with prefilled DeviceID + ACL controls (defaults: &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;)\n  - **Ignore**: add to &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;, remove from section immediately\n- Optional: add \"Ignored Devices\" management screen in settings to reverse ignore actions\n\n### Synchronization Model\n\n**11. Full-list sync on mutations**\nWhen &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, trigger full-list sync on:\n\n- Device add (via &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .add)&#96;)\n- Device edit/ACL change (trigger: &#96;.edit&#96;)\n- Device remove (trigger: &#96;.remove&#96;)\n- Unknown device allow (trigger: &#96;.unknownAllow&#96;)\n- Initial activation (trigger: &#96;.activation&#96;)\n\n**12. Transactional rollback pattern**\nFor all mutations when feature enabled:\n\n1. Capture snapshot: full &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96; array (including ACL values, ordering)\n2. Apply local mutation optimistically\n3. Attempt sync with retry policy (exponential backoff)\n4. On final failure: restore snapshot, persist immediately, show error banner with retry action\n5. Log telemetry: trigger, retry count, error class, rollback performed\n\n### Migration Strategy\n\n**13. Backward compatibility**\n\n- &#96;KnownDevice.init(coder:)&#96;: decode ACL keys with defaults &#96;true/true&#96; if absent\n- &#96;SettingsManager.init()&#96;: &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; defaults to &#96;false&#96; when key missing\n- First launch after update: verify all devices have ACL values in-memory, save archive once (no server call)\n\n**14. Migration safety**\n\n- Existing users remain with feature disabled until explicit activation\n- No silent server ACL writes before opt-in\n- Older archived &#96;knownDevices.plist&#96; files load gracefully with default ACLs\n\n### Internationalization\n\n**15. Localization strings** (&#96;[miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings](miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings)&#96;)\nAdd keys for:\n\n- Feature title, body, CTA labels\n- ACL toggle labels/descriptions (\"Current Location Access\", \"History Access\")\n- Unknown visitor section title, allow/ignore buttons",

Summary of what was implemented:

**Change in `iPhone_AddDeviceView.saveDevice()`**

When a device is successfully added (from visitor history, unknown visitors, or manually), it is now removed from the ignore list in both success paths:

1. **ACL enabled (sync success)** – After a successful sync, `IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore.shared.removeIgnored(deviceID: deviceID)` is called before dismissing the sheet.
2. **ACL disabled** – After adding the device, the same call is made before dismissing the sheet.

So if the user previously ignored a device and later adds/allows it from visitor history or the unknown visitors list, that device is removed from the ignore list when the add completes. If the device was never ignored, `removeIgnored` is effectively a no-op because it only removes the ID when present.

**Description of the change**

- **What:** After a device is successfully added (from visitor history or the unknown visitors list), that device is removed from the ignore list when it was previously ignored.
- **Where:** `iPhone_AddDeviceView.saveDevice()` — in both success paths (with and without ACL sync), we call `IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore.shared.removeIgnored(deviceID: deviceID)` before dismissing the sheet.
- **Why:** If the user chooses “Add and allow” for a device they had ignored, the device should no longer be treated as ignored. Removing it from the ignore list keeps behavior consistent.
